items.t: Too many mugs. Nobody knows whose is whose.

alt.1: Too many mugs, every one of them the same person's, none of them finished.

items.t: Three unfinished tasks visible at once, all abandoned mid step.
One good black handbag somewhere it should not be.
A battery bank and a tangle of cable, permanently unresolved.
{1}'s headphones on a surface rather than worn, but within reach.
Shopping bag handles biting into somebody's fingers.
